div.div: صَاهِبْ ↓ اِصْهَبْ , (O,) or صَاهِبْ ↓ أَصْهِبْ , (so in a copy of the K, in the CK اَصْهَبْ صَاهِبْ,) a call to ewes to be milked: (O, K:) it [i. e. صاهب] is a name for Ewes: (O:) in one copy of the K, a call to the stallion [meaning the stallion camel] on the occasion of covering. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
